import sqlite3

def validate_csv(csv_data):
    try:
        for line in csv_data.splitlines():
            parts = line.split(',')
            assert len(parts) == 3, "Invalid CSV format"
            name, description, price = parts
            assert name.strip(), "Name cannot be empty"
            assert description.strip(), "Description cannot be empty"
            assert float(price.strip()) > 0, "Price must be positive"
